text: My method sets no volume multiple: fund flow is read through COM (subcomponents.flow.cmf), unserved, so flow is a declared caution, not a level I can write. day_vol 1.01 is O'Neil's test; I do not concede on it. What arms me is price: trade_above:bar_high on D, 1 tick over Friday's high, re-placed at each new prior-day high (C27). Fresh break, D HH/HL 0.3% above the last swing high, ret_63d 10.13. Wrong on a daily close below max(fib_swing_low, base_low_20d) (C14). Clears my reservation: horizon_sessions 10 widened past two weeks (C22).
